The initial result from DuckDuckGo was incorrect, probably because it might have been citing an older or less accurate source.

So, the mistake was made by the WebSurfer during the second step when they provided the incorrect founding year of 1893. The reason for the mistake is that the WebSurfer might have relied on an outdated or less reliable source, which provided the wrong founding year. The correct information was obtained from more authoritative sources like The Canadian Encyclopedia and the NCWC's official website.
